name: Basil Pesto Tortellini with Roasted Peppers, Zucchini & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into thin pieces. Add to the baking sheets with the zucchini.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers, then add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until zucchini are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add tortellini, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message: 765 g cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the tortellini is done, drain and return to the pot. Cover and set aside to keep warm.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add roasted veggies and pesto to the pot with the tortellini; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
